Margin vs padding
Margin is the outside spacing of a box. Padding is the inner spacing between content and border.
Margin එක element එකට පිටතින් ඉඩ හදෙනවා. Padding එක content සහ border අතර ඉඩ

Interview question: Which property moves content away from its own border?
Answer: Padding. Margin separates the box from its surroundings.
